mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact own-action exponential-wall FRW, corrected ADM constraint reduction, independent kinetic Schur complement and Lean positivity; bounded spectra and time-dependent amplification witnesses for two specified parameter families.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact rational functions and real Lean algebra; 65-digit spectra; float64 adaptive evolution cross-checked by 50-digit RK4.
mathematics.conventions: Signature -+++; unitary clock tau=t; spatial h_ij=a^2 exp(-2 Phi) delta_ij; physical kinetic=-EL acceleration matrix; outside-kernel intrinsic Hessian healing; c13=0.

bounds.geometry: Homogeneous spatially flat FRW and linear scalar perturbations, single nonzero Fourier direction; scalar plus Lambda background only
bounds.kinetic_theorem: Every a,c14,c2,eps,-F_Q,k>0 and arbitrary real H,Q; full chosen beta family also excludes c14=2
bounds.evolution: Constant: a=.1 to .1 exp(.01), k=.1/Mpc. Response: a=.5 to .5 exp(.004), k=.001/Mpc. Largest-real-eigenvector initial data at interval start; amplitudes rescalable within linear theory.
bounds.evolution_controls: DOP853 rtol1e-10/1e-12, Radau rtol1e-11, 50-digit RK4 200/400 steps; coefficient check at 7 points

non_claims: No universal stability or instability theorem for all allowed actions or wells
No full nonlinear Dirac analysis, strong-coupling bound, radiation/baryon dynamics or observational likelihood
Lean does not formalize the action-to-matrix derivation or numerical evolution
No interval-arithmetic proof or global cosmic growth history
No claim that the state-dependent response trial repairs the theory
